title: The derived algebraic residue of a constant finite-quotient model
statement: Let X be a scheme, (A,I) an adic coefficient datum, phi the finite constant-coefficient isomorphisms satisfying both transition and scalar compatibility equations, and M a derived completed-coefficient object. Suppose the residue of M admits etale-locally constant finite-projective models in [a,b] over a chart V. Let W -> V be a nonempty etale chart, n a natural number, and P any complex over B = A/I^(n+1) whose changed constant realization is isomorphic to the actual nth reduction of M after derived restriction to W. Let J be the image of I in B. Then there exist a total left derived scalar-extension functor L:D(B)->D(B/J), its universal counit for the usual scalar-extension functor, and a complex E of projective B/J-modules strictly supported in [a,b], with L(Q(P)) isomorphic to Q(E). This states a bounded projective model only after residue reduction, and asserts neither a projective model nor a Tor bound for Q(P).

source.place: Tag 094I, lemma-bounded, part (2), derived residue identification; Tag 094G, lemma-locally-constant; proetale.tex Tag 09C2, constant complex descriptions

proof.text: Set B=A/I^(n+1), J=I B, B0=A/I^1. Construct rho:B/J≃B0 with DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotOfLE and Ideal.quotEquivOfEq. Its quotient square follows by testing classes from A. Apply [lem-pc-base-derived-extension-resolution] to B->B/J and retain L, epsilon and its universal property.

Pull back the covering sieve of the residue-model hypothesis along W->V. Scheme.mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff gives a member Z->W through a chosen point w of W, so Z is nonempty. The hypothesis supplies a complex E0 over B0 with the fixed support and projective terms and a residue-model isomorphism on Z. Further restriction preserves the nth model isomorphism: exact overMap and [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction] identify iterated restriction with direct restriction, including the canonical representative comparisons.

Let K be the canonical localization representative of L(Q(P)), F restriction along rho inverse, and C=F(K). Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-quotient-model-residue-comparison] on Z and compose its inverse with the supplied E0 residue-model isomorphism. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-constant-slice-iso-reflects] to this isomorphism of constant realizations on the nonempty Z, obtaining Q(C)≃Q(E0).

Let G be restriction along rho and E=G(E0). G preserves zero objects, so E retains both support bounds. The identity on each carrier is a semilinear equivalence over rho inverse; Module.Projective.of_equiv transfers projectivity. The counit of the coefficient-ring equivalence F followed by G identifies G_D(F_D(Q(K))) with Q(K). Compose its inverse, G_D applied to the algebraic isomorphism, the exact-functor localization factors and the canonical representative isomorphism to give L(Q(P))≃Q(E). This construction also covers a>b, n=0 and the zero ring.

theorem finiteQuotient_model_residueProjective
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [∀ n : ℕ, (koszulConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (V : X.Etale) (a b : ℤ)
    (hresidue : FinitePerfectModelsOn X d φ M 0 V a b)
    (n : ℕ) (W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ V)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))) ℤ)
    (hchart : Nonempty W.left)
    (e : Nonempty
      (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing X d n)
          ((toProEt X).obj W) ((completedAdicQuotientReduction X d n).obj M) ≅
        ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing X d n)
          ((toProEt X).obj W) ((completedAdicDerivedChange X (φ n)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (finiteModelConstantComplex X _ P))))) :
    let B := A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)
    let J := d.ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))
    ∃ (L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} B) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} (B ⧸ J)))
      (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
        @Functor.mapHomotopyCategory _ _ _ _ _ _ _
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk J))
          (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)).left_adjoint_additive
          (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh),
      L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)) ∧
      ∃ E : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} (B ⧸ J)) ℤ,
        E.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ E.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Projective (B ⧸ J) (E.X i)) ∧
        Nonempty (L.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj E)
